name: Microsoft To Do
description: Task-list application with lists, steps, due dates, reminders, repeat schedules, notes and related task-management features.
intended_use: Inspect a mainstream task-management option for externalising tasks, deadlines and reminders.
audience_or_context: People who want a digital list/reminder system; not specific to any diagnosis.
limitations: A task list does not resolve every barrier to starting or completing work and can itself become another system to maintain.
Features, account requirements and platform support can change.
cost_or_access_notes: Available with a Microsoft account on supported platforms; associated Microsoft services or devices may have separate costs.
conflicts_of_interest: Microsoft develops the product; ND Oracle lists functions rather than claiming clinical or productivity efficacy.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
